subject.title: fix(ollama): remote Ollama streaming stalls at model_call:started on slow hosts

question: Should native Ollama streams treat timeoutSeconds as a progress-refreshed idle timeout, matching sibling streaming transports, rather than the documented total guarded-fetch abort?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but it changes a published provider timeout contract that can affect existing users' resource caps and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Accept idle-timeout semantics after proof
options.body: Update the public Ollama timeout docs and merge after redacted real behavior proof shows the remote or slow Ollama path completes.

options.title: Preserve a total cap
options.body: Ask for a separate total deadline or different implementation if timeoutSeconds must remain a wall-clock cap for native Ollama streams.

options.title: Pause for live diagnosis
options.body: Keep this PR open until the canonical issue has live remote-Ollama reproduction that confirms this is the right boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept idle-timeout semantics after proof
recommendation.body: Update the public Ollama timeout docs and merge after redacted real behavior proof shows the remote or slow Ollama path completes.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent history in the affected Ollama stream path and is a good first routing candidate for the timeout behavior choice.
